findings.summary: The test may reach the pause 'through go on a different job of the line or through watch_line'. Calling watch_line directly would skip the real hook path.
findings.evidence: Criterion 5 asks to 'drive the watcher to a pause on that line'. Decision 3 says 'A test must drive it through go, not call it directly.' Fix: Commit to driving the pause through go on another job of the line, as decision 3 requires, and drop the watch_line alternative.

findings.summary: The retry test names b in a two-job line. The dispatch-side lookup by first id is shown only indirectly, through criterion 1.
findings.evidence: Criterion 3 states that dispatch rebuilds RequestRecords, calls group_lines and looks up the pause by the line's first id. The criterion 3 test asserts line_pause and retry, but not dispatch. Fix: In the criterion 3 test, also call go on a Proposed job later in the line, with the pause file keyed by a's id, and assert it is refused. Or cite the criterion 1 assertion explicitly as the dispatch half.

findings.summary: introspect_job runs on Rejected results before watch_line. In go-driven tests it may need a scripted model reply, or it adds noise to the test.
findings.evidence: run.rs lines 145-150 call self.introspect_job(&finished.job, ui) for Rejected or Failed results. Fix: In step 1, check how run_pin_tests.rs scripts or skips introspection, and make sure the test Script covers it so watch_line still runs.

summary: I read the code; nothing was run. Everything the plan names exists. In scope_guard.rs: group_lines (line 77), t3_cost (line 215), evaluate_before_attempt (line 309) and RequestRecord. Also Athena::go (run.rs line 142, where the new hook goes next to introspect_job and note_finished), the private dispatch (run.rs line 322), Athena::retry (reading.rs line 699, which calls ask with "try again on <id>"), StatusView (status.rs line 100), and Registry::register and entries (procs.rs lines 135 and 151). Forecasts.reader.cost_usd is a Quantiles with p90() (records.rs line 303), and the Totals doc says cost_usd forecasts the producer and verifier invocations, so decision 4 matches the user's choice. The checks sit where a dispatch begins: at the top of dispatch, which also covers its re-read recursion, and in retry before ask. The criterion 1 demonstration drives the pause through go. Its third job's id differs from the line's first id, so it also tests the dispatch-side lookup by first id. Each demonstration has a control and would fail without the behavior. The plan adds no athena.toml field and fits one producer run. The findings below are minor.
